A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe the same YOLOE work. The text, equations, Tables 1–8, Figures 1–9, and Appendices A–C support reliable comparison despite layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original YOLOE experiments on LVIS and COCO, component ablations in Tables 5–7, and additional LRPC analysis and qualitative results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 reports original YOLOE detection, segmentation, prompt-free evaluation, and transfer results, together with component ablations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.5 retain the same architecture, RepRTA, SAVPE, LRPC, training objectives, and inference procedures. No algorithmic step or component changes.

E1.justification: Both train on Objects365 and GoldG, including GQA and Flickr30k, evaluate on LVIS, and transfer to COCO. Text, visual, and prompt-free scenarios and the appendix demonstrations are retained.

E2.justification: The comparison tables retain the same baselines, including YOLO-World variants, T-Rex2, GenerateU, and closed-set YOLOs; ablation controls also remain unchanged. MQ-Det is removed only from related work, where it was not an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and table captions preserve the evaluation splits, AP metrics, 16-image visual-prompt sampling, model scales, training and fine-tuning budgets, and FPS measurement procedures.

E4.justification: Tables 5–7 retain the same roadmap, SAVPE mask-pooling and group-number ablations, and LRPC threshold analysis. Appendix B's retained-anchor analysis and Appendix C's qualitative cases are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Their statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported table values and qualitative findings are retained. For example, YOLOE-v8-S has 27.9 AP in Table 1, and fully tuned YOLOE-v8-L has 53.0 APb and 42.7 APm in Table 4 in both versions. Figure 5's plotted results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), embedding definitions, the re-parameterization derivation, and the LRPC selection rule are mathematically unchanged. No formal assumption, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same unified detection-and-segmentation contribution, three proposed components, efficiency claims, and LVIS/COCO performance claims.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of the detection–segmentation trade-off, SAVPE's spatial weighting, and LRPC's redundant-anchor filtering. No new limitations, failure conditions, or applicability qualifications appear.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain the same implementation settings, mask processing, hardware, and training times. The abstract replaces the displayed repository URL with 'here', but the embedded link points to the same repository.

R1.justification: v2 removes the MQ-Det discussion and reference, and deletes standalone descriptions of DetCLIP and SAM while retaining citations to those works. This modestly reduces related-work coverage without changing YOLOE's central research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 expands author affiliations, identifies the corresponding author, adds Section 6 acknowledgments, and shortens several related-work passages. The scientific narrative and main section order remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1, 2, and 4 receive modest sizing changes. Appendix material, including Table 8 and Figure 5, shifts from PDF page 13 to page 12, and printed page numbers disappear. The figures, table structures, and two-column design are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 provides more precise author and funding attribution and slightly less related-work detail. The scientific reasoning, experimental support, reproducibility information, and substantive qualifications remain unchanged. The limited editorial and layout adjustments produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
